g.text: J1 pins 1–3 are SER, SRCLK and RCLK. Connect /OE low and /SRCLR high; add local decoupling. See the detailed wiring diagram for LED outputs and resistors.

g.desc: J1 pins 1–3 are SER, SRCLK and RCLK. Connect /OE low and /SRCLR high; add local decoupling. See the detailed wiring diagram for LED outputs and resistors.

g.text: Use a 5 V-compatible 74HC595 and limit LED current and total package current. Physical circuit was not tested.
